bladestalker333: Valentin Bladestalker reported to S-F1 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Valentin Bladestalker kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
gunnar_durham2325: Benedikt Durham took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Benedikt Durham became a runner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Orders assigned Benedikt Durham to work as a chaplain. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Benedikt Durham and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.

Rumour reached R-F15 that the war would be over by spring. Benedikt Durham has heard it before. So has everyone. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Benedikt Durham folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Benedikt Durham and Gideon Actioncam divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Benedikt Durham asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A letter from home reached Benedikt Durham before dusk. Benedikt Durham read it twice and slept a little easier.
Benedikt Durham taught Gideon Actioncam to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
max.kattawar: Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.

Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at R-F7 changed before the cheering ended. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar shouldered another load.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F7 and grazed Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu).
The medics cleaned Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F7.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar approved the method.
yoi.photo: Nils Photo reached S-F8 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A bullet found Nils Photo at S-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Rafael "Bones" Gaita of the Hegemony (@gaita_4119). Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Nils Photo could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Nils Photo spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should.
Nils Photo never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Nils Photo called across from the Concord line. Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
